MAMATHA GAYATRI

AI ENGINEER|DATA SCIENTIST

(+91)8328023923| gayatrindu@gmail.com| https://www.linkedin.com/in/mamathachebrole|Bangalore,karnataka

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY	

I am an AI Engineer with 4.8 years of experience at Market Cloud LTD, a UK-based consulting company. I specialize in developing generative AI models, multi-agent systems, and advanced data analytics solutions. With MTech in AI and Data Science, I bring expertise in deep learning, Python, SQL, NLP, and cloud-based platforms. I am skilled at automating business workflows and delivering scalable, impactful solutions that drive efficiency and innovation.

TECHNICAL SKILLS	

Large Language Models (LLMs): OpenAI (GPT-3, GPT-4, GCP Gemini , MED -PALM2), Fine-tuning, Prompt Engineering

Generative AI: Text Generation, Code Generation, Image Generation.

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): Vector Databases (Chroma, FAISS, Pinecone), Knowledge Base Integration.

Frameworks & Libraries: Crew AI, Lang chain, ADK, MCP, Stream lit,Lang chain,Lang graph.

Tools: PySpark, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy, Django, Flask

Databases: SQL Server, MySQL.

Programming language: Python.

Machine learning and Deep learning : Neuralnetworks,NLP,probabilistic models,Bayesiannetworks, Markovmodels,ML Algorithms.

Probability & Statistics :Bayesian Networks, Markov Models

Cloud Technology:Microsoft Azure (Data Bricks, Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Warehouse), AWS Services.

Visualization: Power BI, Tableau.

 WORK EXPERIENCE	 COMPANY: MARKET CLOUD LTD.

PROJECT 1: GCP VERTEX AI CONVERSATIONAL ASSISTANT (RAG BASED). INDUSTRY: HEALTH CARE

DURATION: OCT 2023 – JAN 2025 ROLE: AI ENGINEER

Job Description and Responsibilities 

This project leverages Google Cloud Platform's Vertex AI to build an intelligent, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)- based conversational chatbot. The system combines large language models (LLMs) Med-PaLM2with real- time data retrieval to provide accurate, context-aware responses for enterprise use cases.

Implemented Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to fetch real-time, accurate responses from PDFs, FAQs, and We built a pipeline to ingest, index, and regularly sync data from Discord threads & pinned messages, website (FAQs, help articles), PDFs, docs, spreadsheets.

Work on specific customer projects to produce deliverables involving development and maintenance of predictive or LLM models as per specific customer requirements.

Fine-tuned LLMs (Med-PaLM2) for domain-specific responses.

Optimized embedding models for semantic search.

Implemented prompt engineering to improve chatbot accuracy.

Evaluated model performance using Vertex AI Evaluation tools.

Deployed on AWS cloud services.

Served over 10,000 end-users with AI-powered solutions.

Faster Response Times: RAG-powered knowledge retrieval (documents, FAQs, manuals) by 20-40%

Create and configure the GCP project, enable required APIs (Vertex AI, Cloud Storage).

Set up Cloud Storage buckets with appropriate folder structure catalogue and inventory.

Key Technologies: Python Vertex AI, LLM Med-PaLM2, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Stream lit.AWS.



PROJECT 2: AI-DRIVEN MULTI-AGENT ORDER MANAGEMENT SYSTEM INDUSTRY:

FMCG

DURATION: JUL 2022 – SEP 2023 ROLE: AI ENGINEER

Job Description and Responsibilities 

Architected and implemented a sophisticated multi-agent AI system leveraging Python and CrewAI to revolutionize the order taking and initial handling process.

Developed specialized agents (e.g., Order Intake Agent, Customer Verification Agent, Product Availability Agent, Order Finalization Agent) to autonomously manage different stages of the order lifecycle.

Equipped agents with bespoke tooling capabilities for critical functions such as parsing order details, validating customer information, checking inventory status, and generating order summaries.

Focused on enhancing order accuracy, reducing processing time, and improving overall efficiency in the order management pipeline.

Lead the development, deployment, and optimization of llm models, with an emphasis on generative AI capabilities.

Designed and implemented scalable data pipelines and workflows to support AI model training and inference.

Key Technologies: Python, Crew ai, Stream lit, LLM Open ai Gpt-3.5,Azure

PROJECT 3: INVOICE SCANNER AI AGENT INDUSTRY: MANUFACTURING DURATION: JUL 2021 – JUN 2022 ROLE: DATASCIENTIST

Job Description and Responsibilities 

Developed and integrated an AI-powered Invoice Scanner Agent as part of the Buzzy Project, an intelligent automation platform for business workflows. The AI agent automates invoice processing, data extraction, validation, and integration with accounting systems, reducing manual effort and improving accuracy.

Conceptualize problems, apply appropriate theory, explore approaches, simulate, and implement them with minimal supervision.

Implemented Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques for entity recognition and validation.

Fine-tuned models for multi-format invoices (PDF, JPEG, PNG, emails) to improve accuracy.

Accurately scan and ingest invoices received in various formats (PDF, email, paper via OCR, image, EDI).

Identify invoices with errors, ambiguities, or failed validation/matching.

Trigger the next steps in the approval workflow automatically based on rules (amount thresholds, department).

Generate reports on key metrics: Processing Volume & Speed (cycle time), Capture Accuracy Rate & Error Types

Reduced invoice processing time from 5-10 minutes per invoice to under 30 seconds.

Achieved 90+ accuracy in automated data extraction.

Cut operational costs by 40% by minimizing manual data entry.

Key Technologies: Python, LLM GPT 4, TensorFlow, PyTorch, NLP, AWS.

PROJECT 4: RECOMMENDATION SYSYTEM USING PROBABALISTIC MODEL. INDUSTRY: CHEMICAL INDUSTRY

DURATION: JUL 2020 – JUN 2021 ROLE: Jr DATA SCIENTIST

Job Description and Responsibilities

To build recommendation system by using Probabilistic model which is a forecasting model.

We proposed a new probabilistic approach for product recommendations using deep learning framework, combining information from historical observations, similar users and prior knowledge. The deep learning approach is using autoregressive recurrent networks to model the recommendations probabilistically from a Bernoulli distribution.

Developed predictive analytics models for marketing and sales, increasing revenue by 15% through targeted promotional campaigns.

Applied critical thinking to develop and implement data-driven solutions for complex business problems



Utilized understanding of physics to enhance the accuracy of machine learning algorithms

Proven track record of flexible methodologies towards complex statistical analysis and predictive modelling

Utilized python to implement unsupervised machine learning techniques for time series anomaly detection on 3TB of unstructured data, which reduced total process time by 20%.

Key Technologies: Python, Neural networks, SQL, pandas, Numpy,Pandas,Azure

 TRAINING PROJECTS	

SALES INSIGHTS -- Personal Project- INEURON INSTITUTE. JUNE 2020

Involved in Requirement gathering with various clients for various use case and Feasibility check for all the requirement with timeline.

Participating in Data Preprocessing Techniques in order to make data useful for creating Machine Learning Models

Building baseline models for the requirements with necessary data preparation.

DIFFERENTIAL PRIVACY FOR DL ON THE MINISTDATASET – Personal Project- INEURON INSTITUTE MARCH 2020

In this project, Global differential privacy would be used. Global Differential privacy in Deep learning involves the use of teacher models trained on unique datasets to evaluate an unlabeled dataset which would be used to train the differentially private model.

The output of a query on the dataset are distorted enough to ensure that the output of a query varies slightly from the actual output hence protecting privacy and at the same time being accurate enough to represent the general trend in the dataset for any statistical analysis on the dataset.

SENTIMENT ANALYSIS O N TWEETS – Personal Project – APPLIED AI COURSE INSTITUTE. AUGUST 2019

Utilized R Studio to perform sentiment analysis on 14,000 tweeter reviews of six major airlines

Performed data cleaning and text analysis to successfully identified the major complaints for each airline

Applied regression and machine learning to produce a final model with an accuracy of 88% and lift of 34%

CUSTOMER PREDICTIVE  ANALYSIS – Personal Project , APPLIED AI COURSE I NSTITUTE. MAY 2019

Utilized SQL to extract data from 8 different related tables from customer sales databases using JOIN and VIEW

Transformed and filtered data by using aggregating and filtering function to improve reporting process

Loaded and visualized data with Python to identify key business intelligences that can improve sales performance.

EDUCATION	

JNT University, KAKINADA, AP.	JULY 2020 - MAY 2022

M.TECH in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science KIEWT ENGINNERING COLLEGE.

JNT UNIVERSITY, HYDERABAD, TG.	MAY 2003- JULY 2007

B. TECH in Biotechnology. SNIST ENGINEERING COLLEGE.

CERTIFICATIONS

MULTI AI AGENTS Systems with CREW AI

AI and ML training Certificate APPLIED AI COURSE

sections.text:
PROJECTS	
SALES INSIGHTS -- Personal Project- INEURON INSTITUTE. JUNE 2020
Involved in Requirement gathering with various clients for various use case and Feasibility check for all the requirement with timeline.
Participating in Data Preprocessing Techniques in order to make data useful for creating Machine Learning Models
Building baseline models for the requirements with necessary data preparation.
DIFFERENTIAL PRIVACY FOR DL ON THE MINISTDATASET – Personal Project- INEURON INSTITUTE MARCH 2020
In this project, Global differential privacy would be used. Global Differential privacy in Deep learning involves the use of teacher models trained on unique datasets to evaluate an unlabeled dataset which would be used to train the differentially private model.
The output of a query on the dataset are distorted enough to ensure that the output of a query varies slightly from the actual output hence protecting privacy and at the same time being accurate enough to represent the general trend in the dataset for any statistical analysis on the dataset.
SENTIMENT ANALYSIS O N TWEETS – Personal Project – APPLIED AI COURSE INSTITUTE. AUGUST 2019
Utilized R Studio to perform sentiment analysis on 14,000 tweeter reviews of six major airlines
Performed data cleaning and text analysis to successfully identified the major complaints for each airline
Applied regression and machine learning to produce a final model with an accuracy of 88% and lift of 34%
CUSTOMER PREDICTIVE  ANALYSIS – Personal Project , APPLIED AI COURSE I NSTITUTE. MAY 2019
Utilized SQL to extract data from 8 different related tables from customer sales databases using JOIN and VIEW
Transformed and filtered data by using aggregating and filtering function to improve reporting process
Loaded and visualized data with Python to identify key business intelligences that can improve sales performance.

WORK EXPERIENCE	 COMPANY: MARKET CLOUD LTD.
PROJECT 1: GCP VERTEX AI CONVERSATIONAL ASSISTANT (RAG BASED). INDUSTRY: HEALTH CARE
DURATION: OCT 2023 – JAN 2025 ROLE: AI ENGINEER
Job Description and Responsibilities 
This project leverages Google Cloud Platform's Vertex AI to build an intelligent, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)- based conversational chatbot. The system combines large language models (LLMs) Med-PaLM2with real- time data retrieval to provide accurate, context-aware responses for enterprise use cases.
Implemented Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to fetch real-time, accurate responses from PDFs, FAQs, and We built a pipeline to ingest, index, and regularly sync data from Discord threads & pinned messages, website (FAQs, help articles), PDFs, docs, spreadsheets.
Work on specific customer projects to produce deliverables involving development and maintenance of predictive or LLM models as per specific customer requirements.
Fine-tuned LLMs (Med-PaLM2) for domain-specific responses.
Optimized embedding models for semantic search.
Implemented prompt engineering to improve chatbot accuracy.
Evaluated model performance using Vertex AI Evaluation tools.
Deployed on AWS cloud services.
Served over 10,000 end-users with AI-powered solutions.
Faster Response Times: RAG-powered knowledge retrieval (documents, FAQs, manuals) by 20-40%
Create and configure the GCP project, enable required APIs (Vertex AI, Cloud Storage).
Set up Cloud Storage buckets with appropriate folder structure catalogue and inventory.
Key Technologies: Python Vertex AI, LLM Med-PaLM2, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Stream lit.AWS.
PROJECT 2: AI-DRIVEN MULTI-AGENT ORDER MANAGEMENT SYSTEM INDUSTRY:
FMCG
DURATION: JUL 2022 – SEP 2023 ROLE: AI ENGINEER
Job Description and Responsibilities 
Architected and implemented a sophisticated multi-agent AI system leveraging Python and CrewAI to revolutionize the order taking and initial handling process.
Developed specialized agents (e.g., Order Intake Agent, Customer Verification Agent, Product Availability Agent, Order Finalization Agent) to autonomously manage different stages of the order lifecycle.
Equipped agents with bespoke tooling capabilities for critical functions such as parsing order details, validating customer information, checking inventory status, and generating order summaries.
Focused on enhancing order accuracy, reducing processing time, and improving overall efficiency in the order management pipeline.
Lead the development, deployment, and optimization of llm models, with an emphasis on generative AI capabilities.
Designed and implemented scalable data pipelines and workflows to support AI model training and inference.
Key Technologies: Python, Crew ai, Stream lit, LLM Open ai Gpt-3.5,Azure
PROJECT 3: INVOICE SCANNER AI AGENT INDUSTRY: MANUFACTURING DURATION: JUL 2021 – JUN 2022 ROLE: DATASCIENTIST
Job Description and Responsibilities 
Developed and integrated an AI-powered Invoice Scanner Agent as part of the Buzzy Project, an intelligent automation platform for business workflows. The AI agent automates invoice processing, data extraction, validation, and integration with accounting systems, reducing manual effort and improving accuracy.
Conceptualize problems, apply appropriate theory, explore approaches, simulate, and implement them with minimal supervision.
Implemented Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques for entity recognition and validation.
Fine-tuned models for multi-format invoices (PDF, JPEG, PNG, emails) to improve accuracy.
Accurately scan and ingest invoices received in various formats (PDF, email, paper via OCR, image, EDI).
Identify invoices with errors, ambiguities, or failed validation/matching.
Trigger the next steps in the approval workflow automatically based on rules (amount thresholds, department).
Generate reports on key metrics: Processing Volume & Speed (cycle time), Capture Accuracy Rate & Error Types
Reduced invoice processing time from 5-10 minutes per invoice to under 30 seconds.
Achieved 90+ accuracy in automated data extraction.
Cut operational costs by 40% by minimizing manual data entry.
Key Technologies: Python, LLM GPT 4, TensorFlow, PyTorch, NLP, AWS.
PROJECT 4: RECOMMENDATION SYSYTEM USING PROBABALISTIC MODEL. INDUSTRY: CHEMICAL INDUSTRY
DURATION: JUL 2020 – JUN 2021 ROLE: Jr DATA SCIENTIST
Job Description and Responsibilities
To build recommendation system by using Probabilistic model which is a forecasting model.
We proposed a new probabilistic approach for product recommendations using deep learning framework, combining information from historical observations, similar users and prior knowledge. The deep learning approach is using autoregressive recurrent networks to model the recommendations probabilistically from a Bernoulli distribution.
Developed predictive analytics models for marketing and sales, increasing revenue by 15% through targeted promotional campaigns.
Applied critical thinking to develop and implement data-driven solutions for complex business problems
Utilized understanding of physics to enhance the accuracy of machine learning algorithms
Proven track record of flexible methodologies towards complex statistical analysis and predictive modelling
Utilized python to implement unsupervised machine learning techniques for time series anomaly detection on 3TB of unstructured data, which reduced total process time by 20%.
Key Technologies: Python, Neural networks, SQL, pandas, Numpy,Pandas,Azure

sections.label: Projects
sections.text:
PROJECTS	
SALES INSIGHTS -- Personal Project- INEURON INSTITUTE. JUNE 2020
Involved in Requirement gathering with various clients for various use case and Feasibility check for all the requirement with timeline.
Participating in Data Preprocessing Techniques in order to make data useful for creating Machine Learning Models
Building baseline models for the requirements with necessary data preparation.
DIFFERENTIAL PRIVACY FOR DL ON THE MINISTDATASET – Personal Project- INEURON INSTITUTE MARCH 2020
In this project, Global differential privacy would be used. Global Differential privacy in Deep learning involves the use of teacher models trained on unique datasets to evaluate an unlabeled dataset which would be used to train the differentially private model.
The output of a query on the dataset are distorted enough to ensure that the output of a query varies slightly from the actual output hence protecting privacy and at the same time being accurate enough to represent the general trend in the dataset for any statistical analysis on the dataset.
SENTIMENT ANALYSIS O N TWEETS – Personal Project – APPLIED AI COURSE INSTITUTE. AUGUST 2019
Utilized R Studio to perform sentiment analysis on 14,000 tweeter reviews of six major airlines
Performed data cleaning and text analysis to successfully identified the major complaints for each airline
Applied regression and machine learning to produce a final model with an accuracy of 88% and lift of 34%
CUSTOMER PREDICTIVE  ANALYSIS – Personal Project , APPLIED AI COURSE I NSTITUTE. MAY 2019
Utilized SQL to extract data from 8 different related tables from customer sales databases using JOIN and VIEW
Transformed and filtered data by using aggregating and filtering function to improve reporting process
Loaded and visualized data with Python to identify key business intelligences that can improve sales performance.
